summary: Iteration 2 e2e validation of KShopping redesign (Romanian e-commerce). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass — new product schema (tagline, category, bullets, units_sold) returned by /api/products and /api/products/{slug}; admin POST/PUT supports category field; auth and 401/403 protection still solid. Frontend: dark hero with KShopping SVG logo, 'Cumperi azi. Plătești când primești coletul.' tagline, orange CTA all present. Both product cards on homepage display correct category badges (CASĂ & REPARAȚII red on metal.FIX; AUTO & MOTO blue on All Cars Magic Pen). Per-category product landing pages render correct themes: metal.FIX page has red industrial theme with '1420 KG REZISTENȚĂ TESTATĂ' big stat and 'CASĂ & REPARAȚII' label; Magic Pen page has blue/navy auto theme with '30 SEC APLICARE RAPIDĂ' stat and 'AUTO & MOTO' label. Admin login works; drawer now has Category dropdown (form-category), Tagline, Bullets and Unități vândute fields. CRITICAL FIX from iter1 confirmed: Save button (now left-aligned justify-start at x=1272) clicks WITHOUT force=True — Emergent badge no longer intercepts pointer events. Full create→list→cleanup flow validated end-to-end in UI.
critical_code_review_comments: All previous iter1 critical issue resolved (Save button no longer behind Emergent badge — confirmed via real click without force=True).
Pydantic model uses dict default for List[str] benefits/bullets/images which is fine because BaseModel re-instantiates per request — no mutable default leakage.

category field is a free-form str defaulting to 'general'; no server-side validation against the allowed set [industrial|auto|home|general]. Low priority — themes.js getTheme() falls back to general when unknown.
JWT_EXP_HOURS=12, no refresh; CORS allow_origins from env defaulting to '*'. Acceptable for MVP.
Frontend axios 401 → still shows generic toast; no auto-logout on token expiry (minor UX nit, not blocking).
homepage scroll-reveal uses framer-motion whileInView once:true — works correctly but may delay automated text scraping by ~600ms (cosmetic only).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_kshopping.py (rewritten for new product schema with category/tagline/bullets/units_sold assertions)

The Emergent badge overlap on the Admin drawer Save button (iter1 critical) is now FIXED via justify-start (left-aligned) Save button.
